evidence_boundary.established_if_passed: Exact train-release inventory plus measured causal-H4 effective-batch-16 throughput, calibration/checkpoint cost, and peak accelerator memory.
evidence_boundary.not_established: Final development sample size or runtime cap, learning, checkpoint quality, closed-loop competence, val_seen/val_unseen performance, or paper claims.

prior_attempt.failure_boundary: Cache 144/144 completed; exact Qwen loaded; training stopped before update 1 because the runner referenced a nonexistent ActionTokenCodebook.tokens field.

declared.notes: Causal-H4 throughput/memory measurement only; no checkpoint or rate selection.
